scope: Real local MCP bridge, dryland-v1 scenarios, two synthetic remote villages, annual land-loss and restoration chains

player_summary.headline: Big climate win! Street Tree Canopy Expansion cools streets and absorbs rain.
player_summary.youth_takeaway: Playgrounds are cooler at noon, and street puddles vanish almost immediately after downpours!
player_summary.water_retention_analogy: Soaked up 18,643.4 m³ of rain—equivalent to filling 7.5 Olympic swimming pools (or ~62,145 full bathtubs)!

models_referenced: Stanford InVEST Urban Cooling Model v3.14 (Heat Mitigation Index)
